apiToken.description:
API token used to authenticate against the Chronosphere API. Treat as a secret. Falls back to the
`CHRONOSPHERE_API_TOKEN` environment variable.

disableDryrun.description:
Disable the dry-run validation step that runs before every apply. Falls back to the
`CHRONOSPHERE_DRY_RUN_VALIDATION_DISABLED` environment variable (set to `1` to disable).

entityNamespace.description:
Optional namespace prefix applied to entity slugs managed by this provider instance, so multiple Terraform
configurations can coexist in one Chronosphere org. Falls back to the `CHRONOSPHERE_ENTITY_NAMESPACE` environment
variable.

org.description:
Chronosphere organization name (the subdomain of `<org>.chronosphere.io`). Falls back to the `CHRONOSPHERE_ORG` or
`CHRONOSPHERE_ORG_NAME` environment variables.

unstable.description:
Opt into resources and behaviors backed by Chronosphere's unstable config API. Subject to breaking change without
notice. Falls back to the `CHRONOSPHERE_UNSTABLE` environment variable (set to `1` to enable).

clientId.description: OAuth2 client ID of the managed identity principal.

tenantId.description: ID of the Azure tenant that hosts the managed identity principal.

locations.description: Azure locations (regions) to ingest from, applied across all subscriptions. Leave empty for all locations.

resourceTypes.description: Azure resource types to scrape metrics from. Each entry can constrain the set of metric names to a subset.

subscriptionIds.description: Azure subscription IDs to target. Leave empty to scrape from all subscriptions accessible to the principal.

metricNames.description: Metric names to ingest for this resource type. Leave empty for all metrics.

name.description: Azure resource type identifier (e.g. `Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines`).

annotations.description: Additional annotations to set on the generated monitor. Overrides the default `description`, `dashboard`, `resource`, `consumption_budget_slug`, `threshold_type`, and `partition` annotations when keys collide.

instantRateSustainSecs.description: How long instant-rate consumption must remain above the threshold before an alert fires, in seconds. Defaults to 0 (alert immediately on any breach).

labels.description: Additional labels to set on the generated monitor, usable for notification routing. The `resource`, `partition`, and `threshold_type` labels are reserved and cannot be overridden.

filters.description: Filters identifying which data matches this priority. Filters are AND-ed together: a request must match every filter to be assigned this priority.

priority.description: Priority order used when dropping data. Priority `10` is dropped first; priority `1` is dropped last.

query.description: Log search query that selects matching logs. Supports only top-level operations; nested clauses are not allowed and only one type of `AND` or `OR` operator can be used.

action.description: Action to take when this threshold is exceeded (e.g. drop traffic, fire warning/critical alert).

instantRate.description: Configures an instant-rate threshold value. Set when `type` is an instant-rate type.

resourceGroup.description: Resource group the threshold applies to (e.g. metrics, logs, traces). Replaces the deprecated top-level `resource` field.

skuGroup.description: SKU group the threshold applies to (e.g. metrics, logs, traces). Replaces the deprecated top-level `resource` field.

type.description: Measurement window over which the threshold is evaluated (e.g. instant rate vs. rolling volume).

unit.description: Unit in which the threshold value is denominated (e.g. bytes, datapoints).

volume.description: Configures a volume threshold value. Set when `type` is a volume type.

fixedValuePerSec.description: Fixed per-second rate threshold value, expressed in the threshold's `unit`.

fixedValue.description: Fixed volume threshold value, expressed in the threshold's `unit`.

configurations can coexist in one Chronosphere org. Falls back to the `CHRONOSPHERE_ENTITY_NAMESPACE` environment

`CHRONOSPHERE_ORG_NAME` environment variables.

unstable.description:
